title: Application to Study Permit Process Steps for Lithuania
notice: Lithuania has no Embassy in Bangladesh. Bangladeshi students can submit visa applications via VFS Global Dhaka → Lithuanian Embassy New Delhi, OR at Honorary Consulates in Malaysia, Philippines, or Thailand. Lithuania uses a TRP (Temporary Residence Permit) system via MIGRIS — not a standard long-stay visa.

processSteps.label: University Application : via admissions.lt or university portal
bullets: admissions.lt covers most major Lithuanian universities
Application window: March–June for September intake

processSteps.label: Offer Letter → Request Mediation Letter from University
bullets: Offer Letter is the prerequisite to request a Mediation Letter from the institution
Mediation Letter is mandatory for non-EU students applying for TRP — without it, TRP application cannot proceed

processSteps.label: Document Legalization : ৩ ধাপে বাধ্যতামূলক
bullets: Step 1 — Bangladesh MoFA: SSC, HSC, Degree, Transcript ও PCC Apostille/attestation
Step 2 — Bangladesh Embassy Poland: লিথুয়ানিয়ায় বাংলাদেশের কোনো Embassy নেই, নিকটস্থটি পোল্যান্ডে
Step 3 — Lithuanian MoFA: সবশেষে Lithuanian Ministry of Foreign Affairs থেকে legalization
⚠️ মোট খরচ: ~২৫,০০০ BDT | সময়: ৬–১০ সপ্তাহ — Offer Letter পাওয়ার সাথে সাথে শুরু করুন

processSteps.label: Financial Proof : minimum €8,077 in bank
bullets: MIGRIS official requirement: €8,077 minimum
Bank statement: last 3–6 months, English certified | Sponsor letter if parent's account

processSteps.label: Book Student Housing / Dormitory
bullets: University dormitory: €100–€200/month — very affordable
Housing confirmation required for TRP application

processSteps.label: Arrange Health Insurance
bullets: Mandatory — minimum €30,000 coverage, entire study period
Private insurance: ~€80–€250/year

processSteps.label: Submit Application : VFS Dhaka / Honorary Consulate / New Delhi
bullets: Option A — VFS Global Dhaka → forwards to Lithuanian Embassy New Delhi
Option B — Honorary Consulates in Malaysia, Philippines, or Thailand
Option C — In person at Lithuanian Embassy New Delhi (in.mfa.lt/en)

processSteps.label: Arrive in Lithuania — Apply for TRP via MIGRIS (migracija.lt)
bullets: Within 3 months of arrival: apply at migracija.lt with Mediation Letter + all documents
MIGRIS fee + VFS fee: ~€200 total (~৩০,০০০–৩৫,০০০ BDT)
Collect TRP card from Vilnius Migration Department (3–4 weeks)
⚠️ Two-Strike Rule: দুইবার reject হলে system block — সব documents সঠিকভাবে দিন

processSteps.label: SKVC Academic Recognition
bullets: skvc.lt — লিথুয়ানিয়ার Academic Recognition সংস্থায় বাংলাদেশি ডিগ্রির equivalency যাচাই
3-part legalized documents জমা দিন | Processing: 4–6 weeks | Fee: ~€50–€100
University registration ও TRP renewal-এর জন্য প্রয়োজন হতে পারে

costSteps.label: Document Legalization (MoFA → Embassy Poland → Lithuanian MoFA) : ~২৫,০০০ BDT
University Application Fee : €0–30 depending on university
Air Ticket to Lithuania : varies by season and route
